'''Swoopchasing''' was a discipline of [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]]. The [[Triple Crown]] swoopchasing competition was held on [[Najiba/Legends|Najiba]], [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]], [[Redcap]], and [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="Socorro">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
